title: Earth Observations taken by the Expedition 17 Crew
author: NASA/JSC
description: ISS017-E-005037 (19 April 2008) --- Santorini Volcano, Greece is featured in this image photographed by an Expedition 17 crewmember on the International Space Station. According to scientists, one of the largest volcanic eruptions in the past 10,000 years occurred approximately 1620 BC on the volcanic island of Santorini in the Aegean Sea.
